During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]-old '''Sith artifact''' was stored on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jagomir]]. It was located in a chamber situated in [[Shimmering Falls Caverns|caverns]] that lay behind the [[Shimmering Falls]]. Left behind by the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who once sought refuge on the planet, the [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifact]] was eventually retrieved by a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents.

==Description==
An unusual yet highly valuable [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]]-shaped device, the [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] was inscribed with indecipherable [[hieroglyphics]], and its purpose was not readily apparent to an observer.<ref name="OaAI" />

==History==
{{RPG|''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]''}}
[[File:ShimmeringFalls-OnslaughtAtArdaI.png|thumb|left|300px|The Sith artifact was located in a chamber situated behind the Shimmering Falls (pictured).]]
[[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jagomir]] served as a refuge for members of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tradition of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] who were fleeing the many conflicts of their society. Inside a series of [[Shimmering Falls Caverns|caverns]] located behind the massive [[Water/Legends|waterfall]] known as the [[Shimmering Falls]], the Sith established a [[Burial/Legends|burial]] ground and placed the artifact, which held clues to a powerful [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]], in a [[Lock/Legends|locked]] chamber there. The [[Cave/Legends|caverns']] location was eventually passed on in the form of legend.<ref name="OaAI" />

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Galactic Civil War, both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and its enemy, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], were seeking the weapon, leading the Alliance's [[Senior Advisor/Legends|Senior Advisor]] [[Setenna Hase]] to carry out [[Sentientologist|anthropological]] research on Jagomir after a [[Resolute Base|Rebel base]] was established there following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. In order to distract a group of Rebel agents from investigating the potential presence of a traitor in the base, Hase's [[field assistant]], [[Var Narek]]&mdash;secretly an Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]]&mdash;encouraged his superior to follow up on the legend about the Sith burial grounds. Consequently, Hase tasked the team with locating the site. Eventually discovering the caverns, the Rebels managed to enter the locked chamber and retrieve the artifact.<ref name="OaAI" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Onslaught_at_Arda_I.png|thumb|right|200px|The Sith artifact was introduced in ''Onslaught at Arda I''.]]
The Sith artifact was mentioned in the [[2014]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure ''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]'', published for use with [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying]] system. In the adventure, the exact nature of the artifact is left up to the gamemaster player to decide upon, and this article assumes one example of the item's story significance presented in the product as having applied [[in-universe]]. Alternatively, the adventure also suggests that, upon retrieval of the artifact, the Rebel Alliance may be willing to sell it to academic or underworld organizations in exchange for extensive funds that would help keep the Alliance cell based on Jagomir solvent for at least one more [[Standard year/Legends|standard year]].<ref name="OaAI" />
